name: rankrat
description: Self-hosted MCP server over Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, GA4, PageSpeed Insights, Cloudflare, IndexNow, and optional isolated local Lighthouse audits — search analytics, indexing and crawl diagnostics, whole-site audits, ownership automation, remediation, backlink intelligence, ranking and opportunity reports, plus optional boundary-limited submissions and site onboarding. Read-only by default, scoped to the properties you configure. MCP over stdio and Streamable HTTP, plus a REST API.
